name: Wake
description: A Git panel that works like GitHub Desktop: commit exactly the lines you want, send review notes to your agent, read each commit like a pull request, and switch, pull and push without leaving Orca.

settings.title: Fetch automatically every (minutes)
settings.description: Fetches the current repository in the background so ahead and behind counts stay current. 0 turns it off.

settings.title: Coding agent
settings.description: The coding agent CLI that drafts commit messages with the sparkle button, and that New agent starts for review notes. It runs on your own account, so it must be installed and signed in. Automatic uses the first one it finds.

settings.title: Model for commit messages
settings.description: Passed to the agent with --model, such as sonnet, haiku or gpt-5-mini. Leave it empty for the agent's default.

settings.title: Commit message instructions
settings.description: Extra rules for the drafted message, such as "Use Conventional Commits" or "Write in Portuguese".
